review_notes: I read all of lines 1–195. The file declares no definitions, no @[simp] lemmas, no simp sets, no local simp attributes and no custom simp lemmas. Every declaration is a theorem: finrank_sections_eq, finite_algHom, natCard_algHom_ge, flat_of_field, natCard_sections_eq_natCard_algHom, finrank_eq_natCard_sections and solution. Simp appears only as terminal or local tactic calls, such as `simp [RingHom.mem_ker]`, `simpa [← Iso.eq_comp_inv] using h2`, `simp only [x, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]` and `simp [x]`. These are one-off proof steps. I found no sign of a rewrite cycle, a wrong orientation, competing rules or unwanted expansion. The repeated `hz : z = C.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map φ` rewrite chains and the duplicated Φ construction are proof-factoring and duplication issues. They are not simp-interface issues, so I did not report them under this rubric. I did not search Mathlib for existing simp lemmas on these expressions, because no concrete simp defect appeared. Residual uncertainty: I did not run Lean, so I cannot say whether the local simp calls are brittle.
